recording_id.description: The recording it was drafted from. Default: the session's latest.

name.description: The skill's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, like export-invoice. Becomes its slash command.

description.description: One or two sentences: what the skill does and when to use it.

body.description: The Markdown of the skill after its frontmatter.

scope.description: Where to save it. Default project.
